name: What should I prepare for the final detail walkthrough?
description: Prepare by reviewing project plans and making a list of any minor observations or questions to discuss during the walkthrough for an efficient closeout.

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare for the final detail walkthrough?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prepare for the final detail walkthrough, it's helpful to review your project plans and any specific requests you made during the design phase. Consider creating a list of any minor observations or questions you might have about finishes, functionality, or aesthetics. This preparation helps ensure a productive walkthrough where all your concerns can be addressed efficiently by the Frasheski Construction team, leading to a smooth project closeout.
